content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Triggered: Elevated 429 rate
Service: gateway
Region: eu-west-1
Route: /v1/chat/completions
Customer tier: Hosted
Started: now
Signal: 429_rate > 2% for 5m (current 7.8%)
Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/gateway-reqs?var-region=eu-west-1
Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/Gateway+429s

Sean Gallagher: ack. Who’s on point for routing + experiments? looks like only eu-west.

Miles Thornton: I’m here. pulling traces + comparing to us-east.

Allison Grant: looking at metrics dimensions — seeing `experiment_id` spike on 429s.

Mina Haddad: I’m on routing. any recent policy pushes to eu-west?

Connor O'Brien: release train: no gateway deploy in last 2h. last change was config rollout ~30m ago (console experiment stuff).

Allison Grant: breakdown shows 429s almost entirely on `experiment_id=exp_9f2c` variant=B. Control is clean.

Sean Gallagher: ok likely experiment config pushing traffic into constrained pool. can we disable exp_9f2c in eu-west ASAP?

Chloe Martin: I can hit the control-plane API to stop the experiment. need to confirm scope (project?)

Logan Wright: from exposure logs: tenant=acmeai-prod, project=chat-prod. route=/v1/chat/completions. region=eu-west. started 18m ago.

Amara Diallo: gateway sees `x-rw-exp=exp_9f2c` on most of the failing requests. looks like assignment is sticking.

Vikram Singh: checking dedicated/hosted pools: eu-west GPU pool for that model is at 95% util. variant B points to `mistral-8x22b-q4` (bigger) vs control `mistral-8x22b-q8`? either way capacity is tighter.

Mina Haddad: that would explain it. if B is heavier and split is too high, we’ll shed.

Jordan Lee: do we know the split? should’ve been 90/10.

Logan Wright: looking at config snapshot in telemetry: `allocation=B:50 A:50` (ouch). maybe they edited before starting.

Dylan Brooks: :facepalm: yep dogfood had that footgun — UI doesn’t warn on higher allocations + doesn’t validate region capacity.

Sean Gallagher: mitigation plan: stop exp_9f2c in eu-west (or globally if quickest), confirm 429 rate returns to baseline, then figure out why split was 50/50.

Chloe Martin: stopping now via admin endpoint. command:
`rwctl experiments stop --id exp_9f2c --scope project:acmeai-prod/chat-prod --reason "eu-west 429 incident"`

incident-bot: Status update: MITIGATING (Owner: Sean Gallagher)

Allison Grant: while that propagates, I’m setting a temporary alert mute for the secondary 429 pager to avoid duplicate noise.

Mina Haddad: note: routing precedence means experiment overrides canary on that route. so stopping should revert to pinned model.

Amara Diallo: seeing assignments still on a few streams (reconnects) but new requests are dropping `x-rw-exp` header already.

Miles Thornton: 429 rate is trending down: was 7-8%, now 3.1% and falling. latency p95 back to normal.

support-bot: FYI Support has 2 tickets opened from AcmeAI about EU chat errors. Linking to incident thread.

Sean Gallagher: thanks. once stable, we’ll send Support summary + customer-facing note.

Nadia Rahman: cost attribution shows B variant cost/request ~1.6x control in eu-west (token+gpu). not directly incident-related but consistent w/ heavier model.

Jordan Lee: question: how did split end up 50/50 if the intended was 90/10? do we have audit events for the last edit?

Chloe Martin: audit log shows:
- created exp_9f2c (Kenji) w/ 90/10
- updated allocation to 50/50 (Simran Kaur) 6m later
- started experiment 2m after that
No warning in UI at start.

Dylan Brooks: ok. that’s on us — need validation/guardrails in Console + control plane.

Allison Grant: 429 is now 0.4% (baseline ~0.2%). i’d call it recovered.

Miles Thornton: confirm: only eu-west impacted. other regions flat.

Sean Gallagher: marking resolved once we’ve got stable for 10m.

incident-bot: Status update: MONITORING

Mina Haddad: possible root cause statement: 50/50 split to a heavier variant in eu-west where capacity was tight => rate limiting / 429s.

Connor O'Brien: any follow-up required on feature flag / gating? seems experiment UI allowed high split without checking region capacity.

Sean Gallagher: follow-ups:
1) Guardrail: auto-stop experiment if 429s > threshold per region (hook exists, maybe not enabled?)
2) Pre-flight validation: block start if allocation > X% to non-primary model without capacity headroom
3) Console copy: warning + recommended 90/10 default

Allison Grant: guardrail evaluator currently watches error rate + latency but not specifically `429` for gateway (it’s lumped under 4xx). we should treat 429 separately.

Jordan Lee: also, we should cap max traffic to “non-primary pool” per region unless explicit override is set by admin.

Vikram Singh: +1. can expose a “capacity class” signal in control-plane validation (eu-west smaller). even a simple allowlist (max 10% in eu-west for big models) would help.

Chloe Martin: I’ll open Linear items. proposed:
- ENG: add start-time validation for allocation + region capacity hints
- SRE: add 429-specific guardrail + alert routing to auto-rollback
- DX/docs: update docs to explain safe ramp + regional constraints

Sean Gallagher: please also capture incident notes + timeline for retro.

support-bot: Support wants a 2-sentence summary they can paste to customer. (what happened / what we did)

Sean Gallagher: Summary for Support: “An A/B experiment on your EU route was configured at 50/50 and routed too much traffic to a higher-cost variant in a capacity-constrained EU region, causing elevated 429s. We stopped the experiment in EU to restore normal routing; error rates returned to baseline and we’re adding additional guardrails/validation to prevent recurrence.”

Allison Grant: :thumbsup: also adding a link to the dashboard screenshot for their internal RCA.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: RESOLVED
Duration: 21m
Primary impact: elevated 429s in eu-west-1 on /v1/chat/completions for acmeai-prod

Sean Gallagher: thanks all. action items thread:
- Chloe: Linear tickets + audit/console validation
- Allison: update guardrail policy to include 429 threshold and page SRE + auto-rollback hook
- Mina/Vikram: capacity-aware routing note for experiments (region headroom)
- Connor: ensure beta rollout checklist includes “guardrails enabled” before widening access

Dylan Brooks: I’ll sync w/ Design (Tessa/Kenji) on warning copy + defaulting to 90/10 + “EU capacity limited” badge.

Nadia Rahman: I’ll sanity check that the Console results during the window aren’t misleading (partial exposure logging due to sampling). will update if needed.

Miles Thornton: dumping a quick note: a handful of streaming reconnects kept old assignment for ~2-3 min after stop; not a blocker but might be worth documenting.

Sean Gallagher: good call. add to runbook under “stop experiment” expectations.
